title: KESTREL v1.0.0: Fast k-mer phylogenetic classifier model weights
description:
Model weights for KESTREL (v1.0.0), a fast CPU-native DNA sequence classifier that places reads into the same Poincaré ball coordinate space as BiosphereAtlas.

KESTREL uses adaptive pyramid CLR k-mer features (k=4,5,6) and a lightweight MLP to map DNA fragments directly to hyperbolic coordinates (κ=1.2505, 129-dimensional). It operates without GPU and returns results in 13–20 ms.

Files

  • kestrel_nano_best.pt — 13.9M params, 54 MB FP32. Default model.
  • kestrel_v5_best.pt — 28.2M params, 108 MB FP32. Higher accuracy.

Usage

pip install kestrel-bio
kestrel download nano
kestrel classify --model ~/.kestrel/models/kestrel_nano_best.pt reads.fastq

Live API: api.biosphereatlas.com/kestrel
notes: Training corpus: 29,303 genomes (21,378 Bacteria, 5,402 Archaea, 2,523 Eukaryota). Coordinate space: Poincaré ball, κ=1.2505, 128+1 dimensions. Both models trained with length curriculum (phases at epochs 25/60/100). Tandem benchmark against BiosphereAtlas: 0.976 cosine coherence at 2611 bp, 94.4% domain accuracy at 509 bp. Checksum verification is performed automatically by `kestrel download`.
